worksheet.deviation_description: High discharge pressure in the Crude Methanol PD Pump
causes: Downstream block valve closed
Line restriction or blockage in preheater
consequences: Pump casing failure
Piping rupture with release of flammable methanol
Motor burnout
safeguard_gaps: No pressure relief valve (PSV) on positive displacement pump discharge
recommendations: Install a pressure safety valve (PSV) on the discharge of the Crude Methanol PD Pump upstream of any block valve, routed back to the suction line or feed tank

worksheet.deviation_description: High temperature of the feed stream entering the Still
causes: Steam control valve (TC) fails fully open
Temperature controller TC malfunction
consequences: Boiling of methanol feed inside the preheater or feed line
Overpressurization of the feed piping
Column thermal upset and vapor flooding

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature Controller (TC) on the preheater outlet controlling the steam valve

safeguard_gaps: No independent high-temperature alarm or safety shutdown on preheater outlet
recommendations: Install a high-temperature alarm (TAH) and an automated steam shutdown interlock (TSH) on the preheater outlet line

worksheet.deviation_description: Low temperature of the feed stream entering the Still
causes: Steam control valve (TC) fails closed
Loss of steam supply utility
consequences: Subcooled feed entering the distillation column
Disruption of the column's vapor-liquid equilibrium profile
Increased load on the reboiler
Incomplete separation and off-spec product

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature Controller (TC) on the preheater outlet controlling the steam valve

safeguard_gaps: No low-temperature alarm on preheater outlet
recommendations: Install a low-temperature alarm (TAL) on the feed line to alert operators of steam heating failure

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level in the Still column bottom
causes: Tars discharge pump (PD Pump) failure
PIC discharge control valve fails closed
Excessive feed flow rate
Insufficient reboiler boil-up rate
consequences: Column bottoms liquid carryover into the reboiler vapor return and lower trays
Flooding of column trays, leading to loss of separation
Liquid carryover to the overhead condenser
safeguard_gaps: No level instrumentation, alarm, or controller shown on the Still bottoms section
recommendations: Install a level transmitter with high-level alarm (LAH) and high-high level shutdown (LAHH) to stop the feed pump

worksheet.deviation_description: Low liquid level in the Still column bottom
causes: Tars discharge pump running at excessive rate
Loss of feed flow
Excessive boil-up rate in the reboiler
consequences: Dry running of the column bottom
Cavitation and damage of the Tars discharge pump
Dry boiling of the reboiler, causing fouling or tube damage
safeguard_gaps: No level monitoring or low level protection on the Still bottom
recommendations: Install a low-level alarm (LAL) and a low-low level trip (LALL) to shut down the Tars discharge pump and reboiler steam

worksheet.deviation_description: High pressure in the distillation column
causes: Cooling water failure to overhead condenser
Blockage in the column vapor overhead line
Nitrogen purge gas control valve (HIC) fails open
Excessive reboiler steam flow
consequences: Overpressurization of the column
Potential physical rupture of the column or auxiliary piping
Release of toxic and flammable methanol vapor
safeguard_gaps: No pressure relief valve (PSV) or pressure transmitter on the column itself
recommendations: Install a pressure safety valve (PSV) on the column overhead line, sized for cooling water failure or blocked outlet, routing to a safe location (e.g., flare or scrubber)

worksheet.deviation_description: High temperature on the reboiler process side
causes: Reboiler steam control valve fails open
TIC malfunction on the column control signal
consequences: Thermal degradation of bottom product (tars)
Increased vapor velocity causing column flooding
Overpressurization of the column

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature Indicator Controller (TIC) on the column controlling the reboiler steam valve

safeguard_gaps: No independent high-temperature alarm or trip on the reboiler
recommendations: Install a high-temperature alarm (TAH) on the column bottoms / reboiler return line to alert operators

worksheet.deviation_description: High liquid level in the Reflux/Distillate Drum
causes: Methanol pump failure
Methanol level control valve (LIC) fails closed
Excessive vapor condensation rate
consequences: Drum overfill, liquid carryover into the overhead vent/vacuum system
Loss of column pressure control
Potential release of liquid methanol to atmosphere or flare system

existing_safeguards.description: Level Indicator Controller (LIC) on the Drum controlling the Methanol pump or discharge valve

safeguard_gaps: No high level alarm or independent shutdown on the reflux drum
recommendations: Install a high-level alarm (LAH) and high-high level alarm (LAHH) to initiate high-level shutdown

worksheet.deviation_description: Low liquid level in the Reflux/Distillate Drum
causes: LIC control valve fails open
Methanol pump running at maximum capacity due to control failure
Loss of overhead vapor condensing
consequences: Drum runs dry
Methanol product pump cavitates and gets damaged
Loss of liquid reflux seal, causing vapor blow-through to the product storage

existing_safeguards.description: Level Indicator Controller (LIC) on the Drum

safeguard_gaps: No low level alarm or pump trip on low-low level
recommendations: Install a low-level alarm (LAL) and a low-low level interlock (LALL) to trip the Methanol product pump

worksheet.deviation_description: No cooling water flow to the condenser
causes: Cooling water pump failure
Utility water supply failure
Condenser cooling water control valve (TIC) fails closed
consequences: Loss of condensation of overhead vapors
Rapid pressure build-up in the Still and Reflux Drum
Overpressurization and eventual release or column failure

existing_safeguards.description: Temperature Indicator Controller (TIC) on the overhead line controlling the cooling water valve

safeguard_gaps: No independent cooling water low-flow alarm or high-pressure trip
recommendations: Install a low cooling-water flow transmitter with alarm, and a high-pressure trip on the column to shut off reboiler steam upon high column/drum pressure

worksheet.deviation_description: High discharge pressure on the Tars PD Pump
causes: Downstream block valve closed
Discharge PIC control valve fails closed
Line plugging by highly viscous tar
consequences: Severe overpressurization of pump and discharge line
Piping rupture, leading to release of hot, hazardous tars
Mechanical failure of the pump

existing_safeguards.description: Pressure Indicator Controller (PIC) controlling the discharge line

safeguard_gaps: No physical pressure safety valve (PSV) on positive displacement pump discharge
recommendations: Install a mechanical safety relief valve (PSV) on the Tars PD Pump discharge line upstream of any block or control valve, routed to a safe recovery/vent location

worksheet.deviation_description: Reverse flow of methanol product back into the Drum
causes: Methanol pump stopped while downstream isolation valves remain open
Higher pressure in downstream methanol storage tank
consequences: Backflow of product into the Reflux Drum
Overfilling of the Reflux Drum with associated risks of liquid carryover and spill
Potential product contamination
safeguard_gaps: No check valve (non-return valve) shown on the Methanol product pump discharge line
recommendations: Install a check valve on the discharge of the Methanol product pump

worksheet.deviation_description: Excessive nitrogen purge gas flow to the column
causes: HIC (Hand Indicator Control) valve fails fully open
Operator error in manual setting
consequences: Overpressurization of the column
Vapor velocity increases, disrupting column distillation efficiency
High non-condensable gas flow to the condenser, leading to loss of condensation and venting of methanol vapor

existing_safeguards.description: Hand Indicator Controller (HIC) on the nitrogen line

safeguard_gaps: No high pressure shutdown or flow-limiting orifice on the nitrogen purge line
recommendations: Install a restrictor orifice on the nitrogen purge line to limit maximum flow, and/or interlock nitrogen flow to isolate on high column pressure
